cards.name: Callout1
cards.summary: CorelDRAW callout preset (style 'Callout1' in CalloutPresets.cdss; not rendered, read from the file's own values): a thin ~0.5 pt (0.18 mm, outline.width 1800) black leader with no arrowhead, a black Arial 12 pt label with no text outline, and a white 1 mm halo behind the label (halo.useHalo 1, width 10000). The callout ending is None (no box or line at the label end, callout.ending 0), spacing 2 mm, halo centred.
use_for: quiet part labels on a technical drawing or exploded view
fine annotation on a busy product shot where the white halo keeps the text readable
consistent leader-and-label style across a set of annotated drawings
avoid: Expecting a rendered look: no thumbnail exists, the description comes from the preset's stored values (line width, arrowhead path, halo); check it on the page before a job depends on it.
Measuring distances or angles: use the Dimension tools; a callout is a leader plus a label.
Files going to Illustrator or Photoshop: the callout object is CorelDRAW-only and arrives as plain curves and text; convert to curves first if the look must survive.
cards.applies_to: callout objects drawn with CorelDRAW's callout tools (1-Leg, 2-Leg or 3-Leg Callout): sets the leader outline and arrowhead, the label text style and the halo; not for ordinary lines or text
cards.how_to_apply: Pick a callout tool (2-Leg Callout: Toolbox > Dimension flyout, Automation.InvokeItem("71ed077c-c0ba-44ce-8969-6d868224249c")) and choose 'Callout1' where the tool lists its presets (the harvest records the preset file, not the property-bar control): C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Custom Data\CalloutPresets.cdss, style Callout1. Script: no harvested call applies a .cdss callout preset; reproduce it on an existing callout through Shape.Custom (CalloutToolLib.ICalloutShape): Ending = cdrCalloutEndNone, HaloVisible / HaloWidth as above, Outline.Width and Outline.StartArrow for the leader, TextShape for the Arial 12 pt label (untested).

verified.note: No thumbnail (callout setting, not visual); the leader width, start-arrow path, halo, ending and label values in the summary match the CalloutPresets.cdss params in the batch, and the ICalloutShape members named in how_to_apply exist in the API harvest.

cards.name: breadc
cards.summary: Canvas texture image shipped in CorelDRAW's Custom Data/Canvas folder (128 x 128 px BMP). The thumbnail is the file itself (file image, not a script render): warm tan-beige porous crumb, like the cut face of bread or a sponge: fine pits and holes, soft low contrast, even all over.
use_for: bakery, food packaging or menu backgrounds
a soft organic tooth over a flat bitmap via the Canvas effect
natural / craft paper-like grounds
avoid: Large backgrounds stretched to size: it is a 128 px tile and pixelates when scaled up; tile it (Canvas Mode Rows / Columns, or a pattern fill) instead of Stretch to fit.
Expecting a Draw preset list entry that loads it by name from a script: the Canvas effect's image list has no harvested values; pick it in the dialog or import the file.
cards.applies_to: bitmap: a 128 x 128 px 8-bit palette BMP texture tile, the texture source for the Canvas effect on a bitmap (or imported / used as a bitmap pattern fill); not a live effect on its own
cards.how_to_apply: Effects > Texture > Canvas on a selected bitmap (Automation.InvokeItem("027a90ad-7b51-42e9-a1ed-768099b1b119")) and pick or load 'breadc' as the canvas image; the folder name points to this use but the harvest has no values for the effect's CurrentCanvasImage list, so a script cannot choose it (shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect("PGD Canvas", "CanvasEffect Transparency=100,Emboss=100,Mode=Rows") leaves the image out, so it would take whatever image the dialog holds; that string follows the harvest's template but was not apply-tested). As plain art: File > Import or ActiveLayer.Import("C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Custom Data\Canvas\breadc.bmp"), or a bitmap pattern fill loaded from that file (not tested).

verified.note: Warm tan-beige porous crumb with fine pits and holes, soft and even, as described.

review.changes: how_to_apply: marked the Canvas command string as not apply-tested (the harvest's cmd_status says it was never applied in a test)

cards.summary: CorelDRAW colour-management settings preset (ColorSettings.xml; not visual) for reproducing CorelDRAW Graphics Suite X4's colour behaviour: SWOP proofer CMYK, perceptual intent, spot colours defined by RGB, every file assigned rather than converted. The dialog lists it as 'Simulate CorelDRAW Graphics Suite X4' (live list guid 'Simulate X4'). Default profiles: RGB sRGB IEC61966-2.1, CMYK SWOP Proofer CMYK - Coated Stock, grayscale Gray Gamma 2.2; primary colour mode RGB. Opening files tagged with other profiles: RGB assign the default profile (numbers kept); CMYK assign the default profile (numbers kept); grayscale assign the default profile (numbers kept) (XML ConvertToBaselineProfile / AssignBaselineProfile). Rendering intent Perceptual, colour engine ICM (value Icm); spot colours defined by RGB values; Map gray to CMYK black on, Preserve pure black off; both profile warnings off.
use_for: re-opening and editing X4-era files so their colours look as they did in X4
matching output of an older X4 workflow
avoid: New print work: the profiles and perceptual intent are legacy choices; use a Prepress preset.
Spot-colour accuracy: spot colours are defined by RGB values here, not Lab.
Changing how anything looks by itself: it is a settings preset with no look; it changes profiles, conversions and on-screen colour, not artwork.
cards.applies_to: application-wide default colour-management settings (new documents, and files opened afterwards); acts on no object or selection
cards.how_to_apply: Tools > Color Management (Automation.InvokeItem("5a54114e-af98-4180-b7c5-a27e3532db1d") opens the colour management dialog), Default Settings, then pick 'Simulate CorelDRAW Graphics Suite X4' in the presets list (harvested live as WCuiColorSystemDS.PresetSettingsList) and OK. Stored in C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Color\Settings\ColorSettings.xml. Script: the harvest records no call that selects a preset; the open-file policies and warnings can be set through VGCore ColorManagementPolicy (ActionForRGB / ActionForCMYK / ActionForGrayscale, WarnOnMismatchedProfiles, WarnOnMissingProfiles), but how to reach that object was not harvested (untested).
